accepts: a positive budget and a non-empty list of candidate items (unique id, positive finite cost, positive finite benefit) satisfying the monotone-budget allocation bounds
returns: the funded subset, total cost and benefit, considered and funded counts, tie-set choice bits (null when the exact-enumeration limit is exceeded), an exactness flag, source attestation, evidence qualification, locally measured resource use, and—on the ActivityStreams face—a provider-local receipt, book entry, and causal record. The solicited offer's terms carry an explicit resource-price declaration naming which of the six canonical resource dimensions (asset, compute, erasure, gas, time, wit) are charged and how each is measured; compute (cpu-microseconds via process.cpuUsage, peak-rss bytes via process.resourceUsage) and time (milliseconds via process.hrtime) are priced by measurement method only, and asset/gas/wit/erasure are not priced — erasure specifically because this die's math (tie-set choiceBits) is not a Landauer/coordination carrier, so no erasure price is invented. The completion readout reports the actual measured vector for that execution alongside the quoted terms, so quoted-vs-actual is auditable. No cash price or x402 settlement is created.
refusal: malformed or mathematically inadmissible budget or candidate list
request for a formal extraction or proof of implementation equivalence
request for cross-settlement mutation or unsettled pricing authority
